# Bimota

> Bimota is an Italian motorcycle manufacturer founded in 1973 and based in Rimini, Italy. Known for hand-built, design-led motorcycles that pair distinctive engineering—such as hub-centre (Tesi) steering and composite chassis—with premium components. The official website presents the current model range, brand heritage, and dealer information across multiple country and language editions.

## Models

- [KB998 Rimini](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/kb998): Racing-bred superbike ("La Rivoluzione Nelle Corse") with a one-of-a-kind composite chassis, variable winglets, and a supercharged inline-four; the brand's flagship track-focused machine.
- [Tesi H2 TERA](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/tesi-h2-tera): Crossover model featuring Bimota's signature Tesi hub-centre steering (TERA) and a supercharged engine, blending adventure-touring versatility with distinctive handling.
- [KB4](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/kb4): Vintage-inspired neo-retro roadster with an under-seat radiator layout for a compact wheelbase, carbon bodywork, and a 142 PS inline-four engine.
- [KB399](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/kb399): A condensation of Bimota's racing spirit in a lighter package, with a premium inline-four engine and top-tier chassis components.
- [BX450](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/bx450): Championship-winning enduro/off-road motorcycle with a 449cc engine, aluminium frame, and race-derived electronics.

## Brand

- [Company](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/company): The Bimota company—its essence, vision, mission, and craftsmanship, built by hand in Rimini, Italy.
- [Heritage](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/heritage): More than half a century of Bimota design and engineering history, from the founding in 1973 through its landmark models.
- [Spirit of Rimini](https://www.bimota.com/za/en/spirit-of-rimini): The story of Bimota's home city of Rimini and how the location shapes the brand's identity.
